$comment: Photos and clips for the fictional Northvale Council demo brand. Every file is CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication), downloaded from Wikimedia Commons on 5 November 2026 and resized or trimmed for the engine. focus is the point to keep in view when cropping, from the top left, 0 to 1.

library-reading-room.jpg.description: The reading area of the Portico Library, Manchester: bookshelves, a reading table and armchairs.
library-reading-room.jpg.author: Michael D Beckwith

park-trail.jpg.description: People walking a dog along a path beside the water in a park.
park-trail.jpg.author: D Coetzee

recycling-bins.jpg.description: A blue paper bin and a yellow plastics bin on a cobbled street.
recycling-bins.jpg.author: Selixshiraii

walking-in-park.jpg.description: Two people walking along a park path under bare trees on a sunny day. Portrait photo.
walking-in-park.jpg.author: Janesmith321

river-canyon.mp4.description: A slow pan along a shallow river with rocks and trees (Sanghyang Kenit, Indonesia). 12.5 seconds, no sound, 30 frames a second (retimed from 25).
river-canyon.mp4.author: Ardiishere
